examShortTricks: Trick 1: Six-step classical protocol: collection of variability → evaluation and selection of parents → cross-hybridisation → selection of superior recombinants → testing/release (multi-year field trials) — the ordered list IS the answer.
Trick 2: Examples: semi-dwarf wheat (Norman Borlaug, Sonalika/Kalyan Sona), rice (Jaya, IR-8), sugarcane (Saccharum × Saccharum barbari), millets hybrid — quote two.
Trick 3: Fortification breeding: Atlas 66 wheat (high protein) and iron-fortified spinach varieties — the nutrition angle.
Trick 4: Mutation breeding: gamma rays/chemicals create variation (mohan rice variety); polyploidy via colchicine — the non-conventional methods.
